translations.web: Now, behold, the king walks before you. I am old and gray-headed. Behold, my sons are with you. I have walked before you from my youth to this day.
translations.bsb: Now here is the king walking before you, and I am old and gray, and my sons are here with you. I have walked before you from my youth until this day.
translations.kjv: And now, behold, the king walketh before you: and I am old and grayheaded; and, behold, my sons are with you: and I have walked before you from my childhood unto this day.
